channel.title: AI4JVM — Java AI Frameworks, LLM Inference & JVM Tools
channel.description: The curated guide to AI on the JVM — compare Java AI agent frameworks (Spring AI, LangChain4j, Koog), run LLMs locally, and find MCP tools and resources.

item.title: Spring AI 2.1.0 Released
item.description: the 2.1 GA release adds async client and server API types for MCP, session recall through a conversation_search tool over session logs, Couchbase and MongoDB Atlas vector store upserts, a SQL Server dialect for JdbcSessionRepository, and provider-agnostic FinishReasonCategory normalization

item.title: Your Agent’s Tool Calls Will Run Twice: Idempotency and Evaluation Gates in Java Services
item.description: Vishnuvardhan Reddy Kaithapuram, who builds production AI agents at Amazon Advertising, shows how timeouts and retries make agent tool calls run twice, and how Java services keyed by logical-operation idempotency keys (stored in DynamoDB) and evaluation gates for playbook and tool changes prevent it

item.title: LangChain4j 1.24.0 Released
item.description: adds a Decision Scheduler agentic pattern, CDI support for declarative agents, token usage reporting for agentic patterns, Gemini decision models, public model mocks and AI Service call capture in langchain4j-test, listener linking for nested AI Service calls, and an Infinispan chat memory store; it also removes constants for retired OpenAI models

item.title: Google ADK for Java 1.15.0 Released
item.description: adds typed FunctionNode workflow steps with build-time port checks, a ClassifierNode and LlmClassifier for routing, single-turn LlmAgent nodes, live runs through runLive, and mid-run approval and input requests, plus A2A fixes and a dev server that listens on 127.0.0.1 by default

item.title: AI Root Cause Analysis: Architecture, Testing, and Evaluation
item.description: Ales Justin's follow-up to his Nov 10 introduction (two posts so far): how the open-source Quarkus app lets an LLM investigate OpenTelemetry traces, logs and metrics from a Grafana LGTM stack through LangChain4j @RegisterAiService interfaces, filters telemetry to fit context limits, uses Quarkus Dev MCP for source examination and dashboards, and is evaluated with Toxiproxy chaos tests scored by an LLM-as-judge across OpenAI and Grok

item.title: Akka SDK 3.7.2 Released
item.description: adds evaluator components, test cases with an expected reply for the runner to grade, evaluations started from a workflow run, a DecisionModelClient, OpenAI Responses API support in the OpenAI model provider, and tool call status in ledger records, plus consumers that start from the latest event or a timestamp

item.title: AgentScope Java 2.0.5 Released
item.description: a maintenance release for the 2.0.x line: new defaults for the Anthropic and Gemini models, stricter @Tool(strict = true) argument checks, and fixes for state persistence, cancellation, context compaction and sandboxes; existing PostgreSQL, H2 and MySQL tables need a manual migration

item.title: MCP Java SDK 2.2.0 Released
item.description: adds a modern client and a stateless server for the MCP 2026-07-28 specification, JSpecify nullness annotations and per-prompt and resource-template completions; deprecates roots, sampling and logging, and restricts resource subscriptions

item.title: Quarkus LangChain4j 1.15.1 Released
item.description: @Tool methods accept Optional and recursive parameter types and honor ALWAYS_VISIBLE search behavior, AI service results keep model response metadata, Vertex AI Gemini supports Model Armor, and the project adds an AGENTS.md and Quarkus skills for coding agents

item.title: Micronaut LangChain4j 2.4.0 Released
item.description: adds structured outputs from Micronaut JSON Schema, async and reactive AI services, MCP client tools and agents, supervisor agents, Micrometer metrics, Google Gen AI, Milvus and Weaviate stores, JDBC and MongoDB chat memory, and native-image support for model providers

item.title: Letting a Java AI Agent Request Cancellations with MySQL REST Service
item.description: A N M Bazlur Rahman extends a Java order assistant so a local-LLM LangChain4j agent can list a signed-in customer's orders and create pending cancellation requests through MySQL REST Service endpoints, while a separate trusted path reviews and confirms each request

item.title: Quarkus Insights #267: Sandboxing Agents with Quarkus, for Quarkus
item.description: Sanne Grinovero presents isx, a Quarkus-based tool that gives each coding agent its own disposable system container so it can work without approval prompts, with a host-side proxy injecting credentials and the agent's work reviewed through a custom Git remote

item.title: A2A Java SDK 1.5.1.Final Released
item.description: patch release after 1.5.0.Final (OpenTelemetry tracing for streaming and push notifications, JPA ownership scopes): fixes REST stream completion, large SSE events in the Vert.x client and unset proto3 fields in JSON-RPC requests, and validates the requested protocol version

item.title: Java and the Next Generation of Programming Models
item.description: Ana-Maria Mihalceanu at Devoxx Belgium 2026: building inference on the Foreign Function & Memory API and jextract today, and expressing AI models as plain Java programs that Project Babylon’s code reflection lowers to inference engines and hardware accelerators

item.title: TornadoVM 8.1.0 Released
item.description: binds CUDA kernel arguments to device memory owned by other libraries, adds TaskGraph.consumeFromUnifiedMemory and an opt-in dynamic-shapes option, publishes the OpenCL and Metal drivers to Maven Central, and fixes copy-back and pinned-memory bugs

item.title: Debates, Voting, and Reflection Loops: Composing an Agentic PR Reviewer That Costs Less Than a Dollar
item.description: Mario Fusco builds a Quarkus LangChain4j agentic app that reviews a GitHub pull request with routing, debate, voting, reflection and human-in-the-loop patterns, producing a scored report; reviewing a 2,900-line PR cost $0.45

item.title: Embabel Agent 1.5.4 Released
item.description: adds typed decision specs with LLM-backed decision and classification services, Cloudflare Workers AI as a provider, native thinking support for Claude 5.x, GPT-6 models in the OpenAI catalog, and an upgrade to Spring Shell 4

item.title: Quarkus Flow 1.3.0 Released
item.description: adds database migration extensions for schema management, input schema validation by default, a synchronous runner interface, and ends generated agentic workflows when an agent throws an error

item.title: One Database, Two Models
item.description: A N M Bazlur Rahman explores MySQL JSON Duality Views in Java: simpler document reads/writes over JDBC, optional-etag conflict handling, comparisons with JPA/Spring Data JDBC, and read-only LangChain4j tools backed by local Ollama for AI agents

item.title: BoxLang AI 3.4.0: Gateways, Human-in-the-Loop, and a Full Security Stack
item.description: Luis Majano details platform gateways, a restructured Human-in-the-Loop subsystem with durable decisions and batched approvals, layered prompt-injection/data-loss security controls, and expanded AWS Bedrock support

item.title: Koog 1.3.0 Released
item.description: adds ready-made LLModel definitions for the latest Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, DashScope, DeepSeek, Mistral, Ollama, and OpenRouter models, and fixes Google prompt-cache token accounting and Langfuse/Gemini trace display

item.title: TypeSafe Jev Meets Apache Camel
item.description: walks through six practical examples of wiring TypeSafe's Jev semantic decision model into Camel routes for fast, structured classifications and judgments in integration workflows

item.title: B.Y.O.A.
item.description: Camel 4.23 adds support for bringing your own coding agent, via the Agent Client Protocol, into Camel TUI, paired with Camel Kit to build and inspect integrations in one conversation

item.title: Camel's Local-Model Coding Benchmark, Round 2
item.description: follow-up to the original local-model benchmark post: 31 of 33 found issues fixed in Camel 4.23, with step-by-step accuracy improving from 81% to 92%

item.title: Spring AI and TypeSafe Jev: Fast, Cheap, Structured Decisions
item.description: introduces Spring AI TypeSafe 0.1.0, a Spring AI Community integration with TypeSafe AI's hosted Jev API for typed classification, scoring, judging, guardrails, RAG filtering and reranking, and tool selection without generating text

item.title: MCP Goes Stateless, and Quarkus Already Implements It
item.description: Kevin Dubois explains how the MCP 2026-07-28 spec revision removes required session state so any server instance can handle any request, and how the Quarkus MCP Server's 2.0.x line already supports it while staying backward-compatible with stateful clients

item.title: Authorizing What an AI Agent May Do in Apache Camel
item.description: rather than relying on prompts for security, enforces AI agent tool calls at the boundary using SPIFFE for identity and Open Policy Agent (OPA) for authorization, so a camel-ai-tool-exposed route can safely expose different capabilities to different callers based on verified identity

item.title: What's New in the September 2026 Azul Payara Release?
item.description: MicroProfile 7.1 lands across Payara's product lines, Jakarta Agentic AI support expands to Payara Micro and Embedded (an agent as a CDI bean annotated with @Agent), and a jackson-databind security patch ships across all supported branches

item.title: How I Built an AI Assistant for My Career with Java, Spring AI, and MongoDB
item.description: Ricardo Mello builds "RicAI," a Spring Boot career assistant combining Spring AI's VectorStore (MongoDB Atlas + OpenAI embeddings) for semantic search, a ChatClient with MongoDB-backed conversation memory, and @Tool-annotated methods for structured queries and Calendly meeting scheduling

item.title: Can You Explain the Diff Your AI Agent Just Wrote?
item.description: Viktoria Evdokimova argues passing tests prove correctness but not comprehension, and shows how JetBrains-IDE agents like Explyt surface debugger state and structured test results — with a rule of thumb: if you can't explain what an AI-generated diff breaks when reverted, you don't understand it well enough to merge it

item.title: InfoQ Java News Roundup
item.description: weekly Java ecosystem roundup covering the Jakarta Agentic AI 1.0 specification's M1 milestone release and new project website, Google's ADK for Kotlin reaching 1.0 GA, Jakarta CDI 5.0 GA, and point releases across TornadoVM, RefactorFirst, Groovy, and Gradle

item.title: A2A Jakarta 1.0.0.Final Released
item.description: first stable release of Jakarta integrations for the A2A Java SDK's JSON-RPC, gRPC, and HTTP+JSON/REST transports, built on a2a-java 1.3.2.Final, with a new example demonstrating A2A agent deployment across multiple WildFly cluster nodes using JPA and Kafka for shared state

item.title: ADK for Kotlin 1.0 Announced
item.description: Google's Agent Development Kit for Kotlin reaches full feature parity with ADK Core, adding on-device inference via LiteRT-LM and ML Kit, Firebase AI Logic for hybrid cloud workflows, Room/AppSearch-backed state persistence, and Kotlin Symbol Processing for compile-time tool-schema generation

item.title: One Base URL, Many Coding Agents
item.description: Yurii Kostyukov shows how to probe an OpenAI-compatible AI gateway's availability from Java's java.net.http client, plus token-estimate calibration and credential-refresh lessons from building a multi-agent IDE gateway

item.title: Debugging Is Invariant Discovery
item.description: a Kotlin/Spring Boot/Kafka case study showing an AI agent was tactically useful (queries, log reads) but strategically passive without runtime access, and how making implicit business invariants explicit as tests helps both humans and agents spot related failures

item.title: From Spec-Driven Development to Living Specifications in Java Projects
item.description: Maximillian Arruda introduces SDD4J, a workflow keeping specifications synchronized with code via architecture adapters, testable EARS requirements, and specification-to-test traceability, without forcing a single architectural style

item.title: Did Your AI Agent Run the Debugger?
item.description: a case study comparing two Claude agent runs fixing the same JVM bug in a JetBrains plugin, showing that reproducing a failure at a breakpoint beats reasoning from stack traces alone — fewer tokens, no unnecessary API changes

item.title: Building an Agentic Warehouse Management System — Part 3: Tools, Decisions, and Actions
item.description: Ricardo Mello shows the agent accessing operational data, retrieving business policies via semantic search, deciding on replenishment, and acting through controlled tools that create requests and draft notifications within application-defined boundaries

item.title: Google Gen AI SDK for Kotlin 1.0 Announced
item.description: a Kotlin Multiplatform (JVM, Android) SDK for the Gemini Developer API and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, with coroutines-based streaming, multi-turn chat, automatic function calling, and the Live API, published to Maven Central

item.title: Observe Your Camel AI Routes with GenAI OpenTelemetry
item.description: introduces Camel's new GenAI observability feature, emitting OpenTelemetry spans and Micrometer metrics for LLM routes, demoed via the Camel CLI/JBang with Ollama

item.title: Micronaut Framework 5.1.2 Released
item.description: maintenance release with updates across Core, Cache, Test, Data, Security, Serialization, and Flyway modules
